actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train now resolves tied maximum pairs while scanning the stats entries once, and reuses the pair-count update passes to build the old/new pair sets needed for the chunk index. The merge choice and count updates are unchanged, but redundant full pair scans and sorting of affected chunk indices are avoided.

--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -97,14 +97,23 @@ class RegexTokenizer(Tokenizer):
             # find the pair with the highest count; ties go to the pair
             # that occurs first in chunk order
